title: About
description: Equal parts builder, teacher and the guy who ends up running things. Design, engineering, teaching, Rotary, home, family and fun, plus the past work.
lead: Equal parts builder, teacher and the guy who ends up running things. A childhood fascination with what computers could make has turned into thirty-five years of making it.

Darryl in a grey cable-knit sweater, pointing at the camera

caption: Real photos, none of them staged, one of them a viking.

facts.heading: Design
facts.text: User experience since before it had the name. Information architecture, research, wireframes, prototypes, design systems. I have designed for banks, museums, real estate platforms and a smart fire hydrant.

facts.heading: Engineering
facts.text: On the web since 1993. APIs and schemas, Node and PHP, React and Next, queues and telemetry pipelines, cloud on both big providers. I still like the back end best, and I still read every line.

facts.heading: Teaching
facts.text: Ten years of night classes at Centennial College, teaching web design and development to people with day jobs. The best way to learn whether you understand something.

facts.heading: Leading
facts.text: Department head, VP Digital, team lead. Trust, mentorship, honest process. I have worked with 148 companies and brands, mostly from the inside of an agency.

facts.heading: Rotary
facts.text: Past President, Rotary Club of Sault Ste. Marie, 2025/2026. Service above self, and a good excuse to meet everyone in town.

facts.heading: Home
facts.text: Sault Ste. Marie, Ontario, on the river between two Great Lakes. By day I am the IT Specialist at Soo Mill, which keeps me close to how a business actually runs, which is where the useful problems are.

facts.heading: Family
facts.text: Husband and father. The people who put up with the late nights and the side projects, and who tell me when something is not as good as I think it is.

facts.heading: Fun
facts.text: Sailing when the lake allows it. Singing in a chorus, which is where Track Tutor came from. The occasional viking.

hello.heading: Say hello
hello.text: Old colleague, fellow Rotarian, singer or someone with a problem worth solving: I would like to hear from you.

work.heading: Past work
work.intro: The record, for anyone who wants it. Three pieces of work I am still proud of, and the list of everyone I have built something for since 1993. Most of it was from inside an agency, which is why the brands outnumber the employers.
